challenges.name: fix-saved-orders-that-change
challenges.title: Stop saved orders from changing after checkout
challenges.description: Mekong Books' CheckoutService reuses one ArrayList as the cart buffer for every customer, and the Order record keeps whatever list it is given. Saved orders lose their books when the cart is cleared, show the books of the next customer, and a free gift added to one order lands in the next customer's cart. The old promotions module also adds lines with order.lines().add(...). Fix the code so that an Order never changes after it is created and order.lines() cannot be modified, and rewrite gift(id, isbn) so that it replaces the saved order with a new Order that has one extra line. The test runner reads a list of commands (add, checkout, gift, promo) from stdin, runs them on one service and prints every saved order at the end. The full rules and the output format are in the comment at the top of the starter.

tests.name: One order keeps its lines after the cart is cleared
The next customer's cart does not change a saved order
The promotions module cannot add lines through order.lines()
tests.input:
add 9786041000011 1
checkout
promo MB-1001 PROMO-TOTE
add 9786041000028 1
checkout
tests.expected:
checkout MB-1001: 1 line(s)
error: order MB-1001 is read-only
checkout MB-1002: 1 line(s)
orders:
MB-1001: 9786041000011 x1
MB-1002: 9786041000028 x1

tests.name: A gift replaces one order with a new one; other orders and later carts stay unchanged
tests.input:
add 9786041000011 1
checkout
add 9786041000028 2
checkout
gift MB-1001 GIFT-BOOKMARK
add 9786041000035 1
checkout
promo MB-1002 PROMO-TOTE
tests.expected:
checkout MB-1001: 1 line(s)
checkout MB-1002: 1 line(s)
gift added to MB-1001
checkout MB-1003: 1 line(s)
error: order MB-1002 is read-only
orders:
MB-1001: 9786041000011 x1, GIFT-BOOKMARK x1
MB-1002: 9786041000028 x2
MB-1003: 9786041000035 x1

tests.name: Empty cart, unknown order ids and two gifts on the same order
tests.input:
checkout
gift MB-1009 GIFT-BOOKMARK
promo MB-1009 PROMO-TOTE
add 9786041000011 3
checkout
gift MB-1001 GIFT-BOOKMARK
gift MB-1001 GIFT-CARD
promo MB-1001 PROMO-TOTE
tests.expected:
error: cart is empty
error: no order MB-1009
error: no order MB-1009
checkout MB-1001: 1 line(s)
gift added to MB-1001
gift added to MB-1001
error: order MB-1001 is read-only
orders:
MB-1001: 9786041000011 x3, GIFT-BOOKMARK x1, GIFT-CARD x1
